title: Six women programmed the original ENIAC
body: ENIAC was unveiled in 1946. Six women, among them Jean Jennings Bartik, worked out how to turn calculations into setups of switches and cables on the electronic computer.
takeaway: A machine that could be set up for different tasks created a new kind of work for its operators.
source: Computer History Museum, ENIAC Programmers and Jean Jennings Bartik Oral History
visual: an early computer room with hands connecting a cable between tall panels
